verdict.rationale: Fireworks is API-first: clients point at api.fireworks.ai through an OpenAI-compatible API, and the firectl CLI deploys models with a single command. Asynchronous batch inference also supports bulk automation, so the product can clearly be driven headlessly from scripts. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive auth/API-key setup for pipelines, fuller firectl CLI reference coverage, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
